parameters.content:
## A3b Telegram Approvals
Every minute: asks the approval bot for new taps (polling, so it works on localhost) → only YOUR chat is accepted.
**✅ Send** → Gmail to the **demo inbox** (subject shows the real customer) → note on the Odoo lead → sheet **Reply_Status = Sent** → buttons removed.
**✏️ Edit** → bot asks you to reply with new text → new preview with buttons.
A lead already Sent is never emailed twice.
If you see error 409: another trigger/webhook uses this bot; use a separate bot.
